title: How to create and send an invoice in Billy
body: To create an invoice in Billy, click 'New Invoice', pick a customer, add line items, then press Send. Billy emails the invoice as a PDF and tracks when the customer opens it.

title: Which payment methods does Billy support
body: Billy supports credit cards, debit cards, ACH bank transfers, and PayPal. Apple Pay and Google Pay are supported on mobile. Crypto is not supported.

title: How to issue a refund to a customer in Billy
body: Open the paid invoice, click 'Refund', choose full or partial, and confirm. Billy returns the money to the original payment method, usually within 5 business days.

title: Issuing a refund to a customer in Billy
body: To refund a customer, open the paid invoice, click 'Refund', pick full or partial, and confirm. The money goes back to the original payment method, normally within 5 business days.

title: Billy pricing plans and monthly cost
body: Billy has three plans: Starter at $9 per month, Growth at $29 per month, and Scale at $99 per month. Annual billing gives two months free.

title: Old Billy mobile app login instructions (legacy)
body: On the old Billy mobile app, log in with your username and a 4-digit PIN. This legacy app was retired and these steps no longer apply.
